text:
alice: Heads-up — invoice preview for tenant `acme-inc` shows a 3x credit waterfall on last week's weekend window. noticed while validating the canary, thought i should flag before we backfill
ben: ugh, yep i saw that in the preview feed too. looks like credits got applied for primary + fallback routes separately
carla: do we have an example event id? can we trace one of the doubled events through the pipeline?
alice: here's one: evt_20280312_7f9a. raw ingestion shows routing_tag=primary then later routing_tag=fallback after the retry. both generated invoice lines.
dan: share the snippet of the ingest log pls
alice: ```
2028-03-12T02:14:03Z INFO ingest received evt_20280312_7f9a tenant=acme-inc credits=120 route=primary trace=...
2028-03-12T02:14:08Z WARN router retrying evt_20280312_7f9a route=fallback reason=timeout
2028-03-12T02:14:09Z INFO metering wrote invoice_line id=inv_ln_9a3b source=ingest evt=evt_20280312_7f9a
2028-03-12T02:14:10Z INFO metering wrote invoice_line id=inv_ln_b7f2 source=ingest evt=evt_20280312_7f9a
```
emma: that log nails it — we create invoice_line on both attempts because dedupe key is only the ingest GUID, and the retry path re-ingests with a different envelope id
ben: why does retry produce a different envelope id? router intentionally synthesizes a new envelope for fallback to keep routing metadata, iirc
carla: right, but the metering table expects a stable dedupe_key. we're currently using envelope_id which changes across retries.
dan: quick patch idea: use canonical_event_id (evt_20280312_7f9a) as dedupe_key for invoice_line inserts. that will make writes idempotent across retries
emma: agree. need to confirm no downstream assumptions break (billing exports expect envelope_id today).
ben: also need to consider shadow/backfill data — we have ~12k such duplicates in the last 30d. changing key will dedupe future writes but not retroactively fix invoices
carla: we can run a dedupe job that groups by canonical_event_id and tenant and collapse duplicate invoice_lines, then emit adjustment lines to invoices + mark originals as reconciled
alice: can we do a cheap proof-of-concept on staging using the preview export? maybe run dedupe and generate adjustment rows without touching production invoices
dan: yes. i'll spin up a job: SQL to find dupes
carla: paste the query here when ready
dan: ```sql
-- find candidate duplicate invoice lines
select canonical_event_id, tenant_id, count(*) as cnt, array_agg(id) as line_ids
from metering.invoice_lines
where created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
and tenant_id = 'acme-inc'
group by canonical_event_id, tenant_id
having count(*) > 1;
```
emma: for the adjustment, we should keep the earliest line as canonical and emit a negative adjustment for the extras with a reason tag `dedupe-fallback-retry`
ben: ops: will need a one-off billing run to reconcile invoice previews afterwards. finance will want an explanation and a small audit CSV
alice: tagging @finance in the ticket once we have the reconciled delta numbers. also need to add a dashboard alert to catch >1 duplicate event rate per tenant per hour
carla: UX/Console work: add a toggle in preview mode to show "dedupe adjustments" so customers can see proposed fixes before they land
dan: infra-bot: started a staging job: metering-dedupe-canary-280123 at 2028-03-12T18:10:00Z
emma: thanks. next steps: (1) change dedupe_key in metering write path to canonical_event_id (PR), (2) run staging dedupe job and audit results (dan), (3) prepare adjustment rows and finance CSV (carla+ben), (4) console preview toggle (product/UX follow-up)
ben: small note — make sure we don't break per-tenant credits that are intentionally multiple (e.g., promo + usage). dedupe should only operate at event level, not across separate credit sources
alice: agreed. include source_type in dedupe predicate (source_type='usage' only)
emma: I'll review the PR once it's up. also let's add a unit test simulating router retry with different envelope ids so we don't regress
carla: filing tickets: PLAT-3129 dedupe-key-change, PLAT-3130 staging dedupe job, PLAT-3131 console preview adjustments
dan: putting rough ETA: PR by EOD, staging run tomorrow morning, report for finance Thu
alice: thanks all. keeping this thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deployment metering-service v1.54.2 to staging queued by dan
ben: ping when the staging job finishes, i'll run the CSV extraction and sanity checks
emma: noted. also, let's add an alert rule: if dedupe_rate > 0.5% across tenants for >1 hour, page the oncall (eng-oncall).
carla: will add alert with playbook steps: check router retries, check metering writes, run dedupe job
alice: perfect. closing loop here — will update once finance ack and PR merged.
